findings.highlight: nor do I have a choice.
findings.evidenceJa: もうその意味もなくなった
findings.governingReading: もうその意味もなくなった refers to the point of hiding it now, not a lack of freedom to choose.
findings.explanation: Concealment having lost its purpose becomes Rin having no choice.

findings.highlight: came to an end.
findings.evidenceJa: そこで終わる筈だった
findings.governingReading: 終わる筈だった sets up the reversal: they did not give up and adopted Sakura.
findings.explanation: The Makiri history that should have ended becomes one that actually ended.

findings.highlight: the other is raised to live a normal life.
findings.evidenceJa: 普通に育てるか養子に出す
findings.governingReading: 普通に育てるか養子に出す supplies the two options for the non-heir immediately before explaining Sakura’s transfer.
findings.explanation: Adoption as an alternative to ordinary upbringing disappears from single-heir exposition.

findings.highlight: I haven't really gotten to know her well since then.
findings.evidenceJa: あの子とはまともに会えなかった
findings.governingReading: まともに会えなかった concerns restricted meetings after an already shared childhood, not initially discovering who she was.
findings.explanation: Being unable to meet properly becomes not getting to know her well.

findings.highlight: He explains that the Three Corpses
findings.evidenceJa: 三尸—人間の体に棲み
findings.governingReading: Narration states the legend Shirou recalls, then says he has heard of that but not Crest Worms.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s known Three Corpses lore is attributed to Kirei explaining it.

findings.highlight: The distress you would feel every time they moved would be enough to kill you.
findings.evidenceJa: 吐き気だけで死に至る
findings.governingReading: 吐き気だけで死に至る intensifies the alien-nerve distress through the nausea it causes.
findings.explanation: Death by nausea alone loses the specified physical symptom.

findings.highlight: could never even imagine the depths of her pain.
findings.evidenceJa: おいそれと推測していいものじゃない
findings.governingReading: おいそれと推測していいものじゃない is an ethical/epistemic limit on claiming easy understanding despite his lesser experience.
findings.explanation: Refusing to presume her pain becomes inability even to imagine it.

findings.highlight: she had consented to letting Shinji Matou command Rider.
findings.evidenceJa: ライダーを預ける事で戦いに賛同していた
findings.governingReading: ライダーを預ける事で戦いに賛同 makes the delegation the way she continued to count as consenting to battle.
findings.explanation: Assent to the war through delegating Rider becomes assent to delegation alone.

findings.highlight: they may cause permanent damage before then.
findings.evidenceJa: その前に体の方が保つまい
findings.governingReading: その前に体の方が保つまい forecasts inability of the body to endure that long, not merely a possible lasting injury.
findings.explanation: The body failing before complete invasion becomes possible permanent damage.

findings.highlight: I am trained in Crest transplantation
findings.evidenceJa: 刻印を植え付けた術者本人でさえ
findings.governingReading: Even the practitioner who implanted the Crest could presumably no longer undo it now that the worms are part of Sakura.
findings.explanation: A warning that even the original practitioner could not undo the implantation becomes a claim about Kotomine's training and personal limits. This changes the scope and basis of his medical explanation.

findings.highlight: the condition not to fight as a Master.
findings.evidenceJa: マスターとして戦えなんて条件
findings.governingReading: マスターとして戦え names the coercive command to fight, and says starvation harms her even apart from it.
findings.explanation: The condition to fight as a Master becomes a condition not to fight.

findings.highlight: she may be able to continue her daily life.
findings.evidenceJa: しばらくは今まで通りの生活ができる
findings.governingReading: しばらくは limits the restoration through not using Rider to a while, before the separate warning about Zouken.
findings.explanation: Temporary ordinary life loses its time limit.

findings.highlight: you'll have to fight Sakura, too.
findings.evidenceJa: 先に桜を倒すしかない
findings.governingReading: 先に桜を倒す is Rin’s tactical conclusion before defeating Zouken, with both priority and result stated.
findings.explanation: Defeating Sakura first becomes also having to fight her.

findings.highlight: a priest seeking a divine miracle.
findings.evidenceJa: にのみ頼る
findings.governingReading: 聖杯にのみ頼る contains only: the objection is exclusive reliance instead of doing his own restorative work.
findings.explanation: A priest relying only on the Grail/miracle looking bad becomes seeking a divine miracle sullying his image.

findings.highlight: she attacked her own mind
findings.evidenceJa: 自らの心を殺す
findings.governingReading: 自らの心を殺す provides the shutdown method underlying the subsequent restarting-heart analogy.
findings.explanation: Sakura deliberately killing her own mind becomes attacking it.

findings.highlight: the stalled Crest Worms are keeping the body alive.
findings.evidenceJa: 刻印虫のおかげで肉体はいまだ生きている
findings.governingReading: 停止した心臓 is the stopped heart being compared with mental restoration; the next clause simply credits the worms with keeping the body alive.
findings.explanation: Stopped modifies the Crest Worms instead of the heart in the analogy.

findings.highlight: If I can revive her mind, I will consider it a success.
findings.evidenceJa: とりあえずは成功するだろう
findings.governingReading: 精神の呼び戻しだけならば、とりあえずは成功するだろう forecasts provisional success of the limited mental restoration, distinct from comprehensive treatment.
findings.explanation: Predicting success in mental restoration becomes defining what he will consider success.

findings.highlight: Sakura Matou is a stranger to you.
findings.evidenceJa: おまえと間桐桜は他人なのだから
findings.governingReading: 他人 challenges lack of a family tie or obligation despite their obvious long acquaintance and daily care.
findings.explanation: Being unrelated becomes being a stranger.

findings.highlight: She will refuse to wake up
findings.evidenceJa: 目覚めを拒否しかねない
findings.governingReading: 目覚めを拒否しかねない names a risk used to justify expelling Shirou.
findings.explanation: Possible refusal to awaken becomes certain refusal.

findings.highlight: I don't bother turning around.
findings.evidenceJa: 振り向く余裕などない
findings.governingReading: 振り向く余裕などない marks his overwhelmed capacity after the accusations.
findings.explanation: Lacking the mental room to turn becomes not bothering to turn.

findings.highlight: Let us discuss this another time, Shirou Emiya.
findings.evidenceJa: 今後の話だ衛宮士郎
findings.governingReading: 今後の話だ introduces the immediately following future recurrence and choice question.
findings.explanation: Turning the subject to future consequences becomes postponing discussion until another time.

findings.highlight: the cross He bore.
findings.evidenceJa: 科せられた十字
findings.governingReading: 科せられた十字 is the imposed cross under the guilt Shirou has just internalized; no He-bearing clause is supplied.
findings.explanation: The imposed cross-burden becomes the cross God/Christ bore.
